summary: Historical analogue constructed in 2026. Peloton is used to study demand pull-forward, capacity overbuild and valuation extrapolation. No contemporaneous TRQuant recommendation is asserted.
candidate_lessons: Separate shock-driven demand from normalized demand before extrapolating growth.
Subscription quality does not neutralize hardware overbuild and fixed-cost risk.
High growth plus operating leverage is fragile when demand has been pulled forward.
